name: Octree-based Dual Contouring Edge/Face Processing
definition: An algorithm to extract a polygonal mesh from a volumetric scalar field using an adaptive octree. It processes edges and faces of octree nodes to generate triangles, handling cases where child nodes are not leaves by recursively descending or using leaf approximation.
summary: This recursive octree traversal generates dual contouring triangle indices by processing edges and faces, ensuring geometry appears only at solid-air boundaries.
